    故障排查

    如果不确定问题是否来自自己的图像或模型，先在 HccePose 主环境中运行PyTorch RGB 示例，使用配套权重、图像和相机内参。

    安装与导入

    现象 检查与处理
    No module named bop_toolkit 在仓库根目录解压 bop_toolkit.zip，确认能看到 bop_toolkit/bop_toolkit_lib/，再从根目录运行示例。见环境安装。
    All ufuncs must have type numpy.ufunc 确认运行脚本的 Python 解释器，再在对应环境里安装兼容的 NumPy 和 SciPy。Python 3.10 参考环境使用 NumPy 1.26.4 和 SciPy 1.15.3。
    import cv2 时出现 numpy.core.multiarray 或 _ARRAY_API 按安装文档统一 OpenCV 和 NumPy 版本；混用不同 NumPy 主版本与二进制 wheel 可能导致导入失败。
    缺少 torch.amp 使用 HccePose 主环境中的 PyTorch 2.x 运行根目录示例。.envs/megapose/bin/python 属于独立的 MegaPose 子进程运行环境。
    CUDA 不可用，或显示“Using CPU”后报错 用下面的命令检查 PyTorch 能否识别显卡。即使打印了这条提示，Tester 仍会将模型几何数据送入 CUDA，推理需要可用的 GPU 环境。
    EGL/OpenGL 初始化失败 按安装文档检查显卡驱动是否支持 EGL，以及系统图形库是否齐全。渲染、部分可视化和位姿精修都依赖这些库。

    可以先查看解释器和 GPU 状态，不启动模型推理：

    BASH
    python -c "import sys, torch; print(sys.executable); print(torch.__version__); print(torch.cuda.is_available())"

    资源与首次运行

    现象 检查与处理
    已有 HccePose 权重仍触发 torchvision/ResNet 下载 默认网络构造函数在恢复任务 checkpoint 前调用 models.resnet34(pretrained=True)，首次初始化仍可能向 PyTorch 缓存下载主干权重。
    best_score 中的 checkpoint 显示迭代次数为 0 从正表面模型初始化或继续微调所得的权重可能保留这个计数。可用配套示例图验证权重是否能加载。

    结果异常或没有物体

    调整模型参数前，依次检查以下内容：

    1. 物体与权重。 核对物体 ID、网格和模型元数据，并确认检测器和 HccePose 权重均适用于这个物体。
    2. 图像通道。 cv2.imread 得到的图像已经是 Tester.predict 需要的 BGR 格式，可直接传入。
    3. 相机内参。 内参应对应输入分辨率。在 Tester 外部裁剪或缩放图像时，记得调整内参。Tester 会自行处理内部的缩放和补边。
    4. 单位。 示例中的 BOP 模型坐标和输出平移用毫米，位姿精修所需的深度图用米。转换时使用相机元数据或传感器实际的深度比例。
    5. 检测结果。 查看 2D 输出和所选物体 ID。如果该 ID 下没有实例通过筛选，字典中可能没有对应条目，读取位姿前需检查。

    结果字段说明处理后图像坐标、可选字段和位姿输出；RGB 推理介绍示例阈值。

    可选后端

    现象 检查与处理
    ONNX 初始化时运行 pip 或改变包版本 设置程序可能在首次运行时安装依赖。建议使用独立环境，涉及的包见推理加速。
    ONNX Runtime 能导入但没有 CUDA provider ONNX 和 ONNX Runtime 能成功导入时，辅助函数就会返回，即使安装的是 CPU runtime。需要在当前环境中安装适合的 GPU runtime，并查看 session/provider 日志。
    缺少 TensorRT execution provider 选用的 ONNX Runtime 构建必须包含 TensorrtExecutionProvider；仅安装 TensorRT Python 包不能给 ORT 补上缺失的 provider。
    列出了 TensorRT provider，但无法加载 libnvinfer 安装匹配的 TensorRT 动态库，在启动 Python 前使库目录可见，并核对 CUDA／驱动／动态库组合。排查可选后端时可继续使用已经跑通的 PyTorch 路径。
    MegaPose 首次运行长时间准备文件 准备流程可能克隆 third_party_megapose6d/，在 .envs/megapose/ 创建 Python 3.9 环境，安装独立依赖并下载模型。需要 conda、网络、可写目录和足够磁盘空间。见 MegaPose。
    MegaPose 缺少配置文件或 checkpoint 检查目录是否包含上游配置文件和权重。有些镜像只提供 checkpoint。根据下载器或 rclone 的报错补齐缺失文件。

    反馈问题时，请附上脚本名、运行命令、Python 解释器路径、所选后端、相关文件路径，以及日志中的第一处异常。如果报错来自 MegaPose 子进程，请保留完整日志，方便查看子进程的调用栈。

    WAPR 输入与下载缓存

    WAPR 的包、编译环境和资源准备见安装说明。本项目使用独立的 estimate_from_masks 接口。遇到错误先检查原图掩码、配准米制深度、相机内参和米制网格；空掩码、无正深度和输出数量错误会报错。

    Hugging Face 离线回退可能返回已有目录，因此资源页仍逐项检查七文件大小与两个权重摘要。发现损坏时按资源页重新下载；额外旧权重或说明文件需检查后移出 best_score/，不会自动删除。

    pnp_success=False 表示初始 PnP 未成功，不能把回退单位矩阵当成可靠位姿。默认组合 PnP 缺少 keypoints_ 先验时，会报告 checkpoint 路径；先核对权重与物体、网络架构是否匹配。

    Troubleshooting

    To check whether a problem is specific to your inputs, run the PyTorch RGB demo in the main HccePose environment with the original weights, images and camera matrix.

    Installation and imports

    Symptom Check and next action
    No module named bop_toolkit Extract bop_toolkit.zip at the repository root. Check for bop_toolkit/bop_toolkit_lib/ and run the example from the root. See installation.
    All ufuncs must have type numpy.ufunc Check which Python executable runs the script. In its environment, install compatible versions of NumPy and SciPy. The Python 3.10 reference uses NumPy 1.26.4 and SciPy 1.15.3.
    numpy.core.multiarray or _ARRAY_API error on import cv2 Align OpenCV and NumPy with the reference pins in installation; mixed NumPy major versions and binary wheels can cause import failures.
    Missing torch.amp Run the root demo in the main HccePose PyTorch 2.x environment. .envs/megapose/bin/python belongs to the separate MegaPose subprocess runtime.
    CUDA unavailable, or an error after “Using CPU” Use the command below to check whether PyTorch can see the GPU. Tester moves model geometry to CUDA even after printing this message. Inference requires a working GPU installation.
    EGL/OpenGL initialization failure Check the EGL-capable GPU driver and system graphics dependencies from installation. Rendering and some visualization/refinement workflows need these beyond Python wheels.

    To identify the active interpreter and GPU availability without starting inference:

    BASH
    python -c "import sys, torch; print(sys.executable); print(torch.__version__); print(torch.cuda.is_available())"

    Assets and first execution

    Symptom Check and next action
    A torchvision/ResNet download starts despite existing HccePose weights The default network constructor calls models.resnet34(pretrained=True) before restoring the task checkpoint. First initialization may therefore download backbone weights into the PyTorch cache.
    A best_score checkpoint reports iteration 0 A checkpoint initialized or fine-tuned from a front-surface model can retain this iteration count. Try it on the supplied sample images to check that it loads.

    Outputs look wrong or no object appears

    Check these before altering model parameters:

    1. Object identity and weights: the object ID, mesh/model information, detector, and per-object HccePose checkpoint must describe the same trained object.
    2. Image colors: Tester.predict expects OpenCV BGR. Do not apply COLOR_RGB2BGR to an image already loaded by cv2.imread.
    3. Camera geometry: use intrinsics for the supplied input resolution. If you resize or crop outside Tester, transform the intrinsics accordingly; internal resizing and padding are handled by Tester.
    4. Units: supplied BOP-style model coordinates and pose translations are in millimeters. A refinement depth map must be in meters; use the sample camera metadata or the sensor's actual depth scale.
    5. Detection: inspect the 2D output and the selected object ID. Per-object result entries may be absent when no instance survives filtering; callers should check that the entry exists before reading poses.

    The results reference explains processed-image coordinates, optional fields, and pose outputs. RGB inference documents the example thresholds.

    Optional backends

    Symptom Check and next action
    ONNX setup runs pip or changes package versions On first use, the setup helper can install dependencies. Use a dedicated environment. See acceleration for the packages it may change.
    ONNX Runtime imports but has no CUDA provider The setup helper returns when ONNX and ONNX Runtime import successfully, even for a CPU-only runtime. Install an appropriate GPU runtime in the active environment and inspect the session/provider diagnostics.
    TensorRT execution provider missing The selected ONNX Runtime build must include TensorrtExecutionProvider; installing the TensorRT Python package alone does not add a missing provider to ORT.
    TensorRT provider is listed but libnvinfer cannot load Install matching TensorRT libraries and make their directory visible before starting Python. Check the CUDA/driver/library combination. Use the working PyTorch route while resolving the optional backend.
    MegaPose first use spends a long time preparing files Setup can clone third_party_megapose6d/, create a Python 3.9 environment under .envs/megapose/, install its own stack, and fetch models. It requires conda, network access, writable storage, and available disk space. See MegaPose.
    MegaPose model config/checkpoint missing Keep the full upstream model layout, including config files; a checkpoint-only mirror may be incomplete. Review the downloader/rclone error emitted by the setup rather than copying an unrelated checkpoint.

    When reporting an error, include the command, script name, Python executable, backend, relevant file paths and the first exception in the log. For a MegaPose subprocess error, keep the full log so the traceback from that environment is available.

    WAPR inputs and download caches

    See Installation for WAPR packages, compilation and resources. This project uses separate estimate_from_masks calls. Check original-frame masks, registered meter depth, intrinsics and meter meshes first. Empty masks, missing positive depth and output count errors raise explicitly.

    Hugging Face offline fallback may return an existing directory. The assets recipe therefore checks seven exact file sizes and both weight digests. Follow Assets to redownload corrupt files. Inspect and move extra old checkpoints or notes out of best_score/; they are never automatically deleted.

    pnp_success=False means initial PnP failed. Do not treat a fallback identity transform as a reliable pose. Missing keypoints_ for the default combined PnP raises with the checkpoint path; first verify object and network compatibility.
